newsitem.title: USA: TCI to restructure into six divisions-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: TCI to restructure into six divisions-WSJ.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc president Leo Hindery Jr announced a restructuring of the cable operator into six geographic divisions, the Wall Street Jounral said in Wednesday's electronic edition.
The newspaper also said the company would look to form partnerships with other cable companies in certain markets.
The move would allow the company to focus on the needs of local markets, the paper said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
